M - Major, minor, pre-major, or concentration restrictions. If restricted by date, click on CRN to see effective dates; courses with no date are restricted through the registration deadline. Contact the academic department for additional information.

V - On DuckWeb, cannot drop on/after first class day (after 5pm Fri if starts Sat/Sun) or add after term deadline. To drop or add after these dates, email registrar@uoregon.edu from your UO email. Deadlines based on days of course complete when contacted.
a - Application of software engineering concepts to Data Science and Machine Learning. Students build a full-stack AI system ready for web-based production. This course leads well into CS 472/572.
i - Access to MAC with macOS Monterey and Xcode 13 required for this course.
k - Prereqs: Will require programming in Python, as well as some background in linear algebra, calculus, statistics, data structures. Experience with digital signal processing or machine learning is useful but not required.
p - Prereq: CS 313, or CS 212 with instructor permission
- Dept or Instructor approval required; check course details for effective dates. When approved, use the Add/Drop menu to add the course by entering the CRN directly
